In electrophilic aromatic substitution reactions, the reactivity depends on the electron-donating or electron-withdrawing properties of the substituents:
- Electron-donating groups (EDG) increase reactivity
- Electron-withdrawing groups (EWG) decrease reactivity

Phenol (OH) > Toluene (CH3) > Chlorobenzene (Cl)
